verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a REST API and an official MCP server, and the MCP docs mention headless setups such as CI jobs and scripts, which implies some form of non-browser credential. However, nothing in the pack shows that API keys or tokens can be scoped, role-restricted, made read-only, or otherwise issued on a least-privilege basis for an agent. Since scoping is the core of this story, the axis applies but is unevidenced.
